content: Machine reading comprehension (MRC) BIBREF39, BIBREF40, BIBREF41, BIBREF40, BIBREF42, BIBREF15 has become a central task in natural language understanding. MRC in the SQuAD-style is to predict the answer span in the passage given a question and the passage. In this paper, we choose the SQuAD-style MRC task and report Extract Match (EM) in addition to F1 score on validation set. All hyperparameters are tuned on the development set of each dataset.
